task: tenant-aware web navigation & mobile org context; audit mobile organization scoping, clinic association in patient profile, presentation mode scoping, and ensure X-CLARA-Organization-Id header propagation in ApiClient.

verified_source_anchors.description: Injects X-CLARA-Organization-Id header on all standard REST requests when activeOrganizationId is present.
Propagates X-CLARA-Organization-Id header on SSE streaming endpoints.
Propagates X-CLARA-Organization-Id header on multipart file uploads.
Manages persistent storage and lifecycle for active organization ID in secure storage.
Audited presentation mode scoping: layout/navigation context remains separated from backend tenant RBAC authorization.

tests_run.description: Zero issues found in static analysis of modified Flutter sources and tests.
5 unit tests verifying explicit, store-attached, and override organization header propagation and persistence.
12 unit tests verifying session store persistence, cache purging, and token expiry cycles.
Enforced strict path lane isolation across all modified and deliverable files.

organization_header_propagation.finding: ApiClient supports explicit organizationId parameter, dynamic setOrganization(), and seamless fallback to SessionStoreAuthHooks.organizationId. All JSON REST, SSE streaming, and multipart uploads now carry X-CLARA-Organization-Id header safely.

secure_session_storage.finding: PersistentSessionStore now securely persists and retrieves clara.session.organization_id, reliably clearing on logout or expired token hydration.

presentation_mode_scoping.finding: PresentationMode (personal, clinical, research, admin) confirmed to modify only client-side navigation and layout presentation without bypassing server-side RBAC or organization tenant boundaries.
